mentions.name: ninja.ai
mentions.description: This is a one-click app store for MCP servers that lets users browse, install, and connect servers in a single click. Its broader goal is a "Universal Fabric of Context" that lets AI tools tap into structured information across the web easily, aiming to make AI integrations as simple as installing an app with no messy APIs or custom scraping.
mentions.problem: Installing and connecting MCP servers is surprisingly difficult, even for simple ones, which hinders AI agents from interacting with the web.
mentions.audience: People working with AI models, agents, or data-heavy tools
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m building ninja.ai — it looks like a one-click App Store for MCP Servers, but the real goal is much bigger: creating a “Universal Fabric of Context” that lets AI tools tap into structured information across the web easily.
